verdict.rationale: OpenCode documents asking the agent to fix an issue, with the work done on a new branch and submitted as a PR. It also offers plan and read-only explore agents for analyzing code, which supports narrowing down root causes. Nothing in the evidence shows it running code or tests to reproduce a bug or verify a fix. Missing for 10: documented issue reproduction (running code or tests), documented fix verification, debugging-specific workflow docs, and independent hands-on corroboration of the debugging loop.

support.subject: As a developer, I can reproduce issues, narrow down root causes, and verify fixes

citations.quote: Ask OpenCode to fix an issue or implement a feature. And it will work in a new branch and submits a PR with all the changes.
This agent is useful when you want the LLM to analyze code, suggest changes, or create plans without making any actual modifications to your codebase.
A fast, read-only agent for exploring codebases. Cannot modify files.
